## code for line plot##
## in filter choose gender either male or female to make the graph##
## choose the full joined data of gender with labreads ##
```{r}
gpt_summary_data <- lpara_alt_data  %>% filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(Attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
# Create the line plot with rotated x-axis labels and error bars for both SD and SEM
max_value <- max(gpt_summary_data$mean_labread + gpt_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)

ggplot(gpt_summary_data, aes(x = Attribute, y = mean_labread, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_labread, ymax = mean_labread + sd_labread), width = 0.2, color = "blue") +  # SD error bars in blue
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_labread, ymax = mean_labread + sd_labread), width = 0.2, color = "red") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "lightgrey", size = 0.5, se = TRUE) + # SEM error bars in red
  labs(title = "Line Plot of Mean ALT for Female",
       x = "Attribute",
       y = "ALT U/L",
       caption = "Red error bars: SD") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))

```

##### code for boxplot ####


```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

max_value <- max(gpt_summary_data$mean_labread + gpt_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)

## use the last joined data gender with labreads##
lpara_alt_data %>% 
  mutate(Attribute = as.factor(Attribute)) %>% 
  group_by(Attribute) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Attribute, y = labreads)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Boxplot of ALT for both gender",
       x = "Attribute",
       y = "ALT U/L") + ### label y axis according your sample name
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))


```

```{r}

setwd("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/Arun Testversionen")

dose_data <- read_excel("Medikamente Arun Testversion.xlsx", sheet = 3)  
  
lvpara_dosedata <- dose_data %>% 
  filter(Attribut == "Leber_Para") %>% 
  rename( "Edited_BfArM Nummer2" ="BfArM Nummer_2" )

lvpara_dosedata
```


```{r}
lvpara_dosedata_gptalst <- left_join(lpara_alt_data,lvpara_dosedata, by = ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!7)

```

```{r}
dd_amount <- lvpara_dosedata_gptalst %>%
  filter(Kathegorie == "Häufigkeit der Einnahme pro Tag")%>%
  rename("numberofdose" = "Dose_mg") %>%  dplyr::select(1,8,10)

dd_amount
```

```{r}

dose_result <- left_join(lvpara_dosedata_gptalst,dd_amount, by = ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>%
 filter(Kathegorie.x == "Dosis (Mg/Verabreichung)" & Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = Dose_mg*numberofdose,
   Dose_mg = as.factor(Dose_mg)) %>%
  group_by(Dose_mg) %>%
  distinct()
  #drop_na(numberofdose)

dose_result1 <- dose_result[dose_result$`Edited_BfArM Nummer2` != "93008468", ]

dose_result1 <- mutate(dose_result1, totaldose_mg = ifelse(totaldose_mg == 200, 150, totaldose_mg))
dose_result1 <- mutate(dose_result1, totaldose_mg = ifelse(totaldose_mg == 25, 50, totaldose_mg))
dose_result1 <- mutate(dose_result1, totaldose_mg = ifelse(totaldose_mg == 10, 50, totaldose_mg))
dose_result1 <- mutate(dose_result1, totaldose_mg = ifelse(totaldose_mg == 175, 150, totaldose_mg))
dose_result1 <- mutate(dose_result1, totaldose_mg = ifelse(totaldose_mg == 187.5, 150, totaldose_mg))



print(dose_result1)


```

```{r}
  group_by(Attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),

  )
```

```{r}

dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Boxplot of ALT for both gender",
       x = "dailydose in mg",
       y = "ALT U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
     plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", angle = 45)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))
  
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```


### plot##
```{r}
library(ggthemes)

dd <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

pp <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = dd,
  x = totaldose_mg,
  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  ylab = "ALT U/L",
  xlab = "dailydose (mg)")

extract_stats(pp)
print(pp)
```

##### linear regression###

```{r}
ww <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```



```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```


```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " ALT in U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2500, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2400, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```


###################cumulative dose = CD #######

```{r}
CD_dose <- lvpara_dosedata_gptalst %>% 
  filter(Kathegorie == "Kumulative Dosis" & Treatment == "Paracetamol")

num_dosetaken <- lvpara_dosedata_gptalst %>% 
  filter(Kathegorie == "Dauer der Einnahme (Tage)" & Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  rename("daysofintake" = "Dose_mg") %>% dplyr::select(1,10)

CD_dose_weekdata <- left_join(CD_dose, num_dosetaken, by = ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  drop_na(daysofintake)


```


```{r}
cumulativ_4week <- CD_dose_weekdata %>% 
  filter(daysofintake <= 28) %>% 
  mutate(daysofintake = as.factor(daysofintake)) %>% 
  drop_na(Dose_mg)  
  
  
  cumulativ_4week <- cumulativ_4week[cumulativ_4week$`Edited_BfArM Nummer2` != "93008468", ]
  
 cumulativ_4week %>% 
   ggplot( aes(x = daysofintake, y = Dose_mg)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
     labs(title = "Paracetamol cummulative dose",
       x = "Number of day",
       y = "Cummulative dose (mg)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
   
```

### Cumulative Dose lower than 10000(mg)########
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readxl)

# Read the Excel file and filter the data
setwd("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/Arun Testversionen")
CD_liverpara <- read_excel("Medikamente Arun Testversion.xlsx", sheet = 6, skip = 1) %>%
  filter(Cumulative_Dose > 0.0 & Cumulative_Dose <= 10000 & Treatment == "Leber_Para")

# Summarize the counts of each Cumulative_Dose
dose_counts <- CD_liverpara %>%
  group_by(Cumulative_Dose) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

# Add the count column back into the original data frame
CD_liverpara <- CD_liverpara %>%
  left_join(dose_counts, by = "Cumulative_Dose")

# View the result
print(CD_liverpara)

  
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)

# Read the Excel file and filter the data
setwd("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/Arun Testversionen")
CD_liverpara <- read_excel("Medikamente Arun Testversion.xlsx", sheet = 6, skip = 1) %>%
  filter(Cumulative_Dose > 0.0 & Treatment == "Leber_Para")

# Create dose groups
CD_liverpara <- CD_liverpara %>%
  mutate(Dose_Group = cut(Cumulative_Dose,
                          breaks = c(0, 1000, 5000,20000, Inf),
                          labels = c("50mg to 1g", "1g to 5g", "5g to 20g", "20g < Higher"),
                          right = FALSE)) # right = FALSE to make intervals inclusive of lower bound and exclusive of upper bound

# View the result with dose groups
print(CD_liverpara)

# Plot frequency of each dose group
ggplot(CD_liverpara, aes(x = Dose_Group)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Frequency of Cumulative Dose Groups",
       x = "Dose Group",
       y = "Frequency") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b = 10), color = "black", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```

```{r}
dose_result <- left_join(lvpara_dosedata_gptast,dd_amount, by = ("Edited_BfArM Nummer2")) %>%
 filter(Kathegorie.x == "Dosis (Mg/Verabreichung)" & Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>%
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(Attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}

dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Boxplot of AST for both gender",
       x = "dailydose in mg",
       y = "AST U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
     plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", angle = 45)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))
  
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```

```{r}
print(pp)
```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " AST in U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2500, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2400, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}

dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Boxplot of AST for both gender",
       x = "dailydose in mg",
       y = "quick %") +
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
     plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", angle = 45)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))
  
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```

```{r}

  y = labreads,
  type = "np",

extract_stats(pp)
print(pp)
```

```{r}

  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```

```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " inr") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 50, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 50, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)
```




```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " leukocyces cells/ul") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 50, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 50, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}

dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  labs(title = "Boxplot of ggt for both gender",
       x = "dailydose in mg",
       y = "ldh U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
     plot.title = element_text(margin = margin(b=10), color="black", face="bold", hjust = 0.5),
     axis.text.x = element_text(face="bold", angle = 45)
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = all_breaks,
                     limits = c(0, max_value))
  
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```

```{r}
library(ggthemes)

  y = labreads,
  type = "np",
  ylab = "ldh U/L",

extract_stats(pp)
print(pp)
```

##### linear regression###

```{r}
ww <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```

```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " ldh in U/L") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2500, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 2400, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

##### linear regression###

```{r}
ww <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```

```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " hb g/dl") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```

```{r}

  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r}
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)

all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)
```




##### linear regression###

```{r}
ww <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```

```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " ap u/l") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}

  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " Creatinine mg/dl") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}

dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)
```




##### linear regression###

```{r}
ww <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(Treatment == "Paracetamol") %>% 
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(totaldose_mg)

ww
```

```{r}
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " hst mg/dl") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
```

```{r}

  geom_smooth()

```

```{r}
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)

library(ggplot2)

# Fit the linear model
lm_model <- lm(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = dose_result1)

#check_model(lm_model)

# Extract the coefficients
intercept <- coef(lm_model)[1]
slope <- coef(lm_model)[2]

# Create the equation string
equation <- paste("y = ", round(intercept, 2), " + ", round(slope, 2), "x", sep = "")
r_squared <- summary(lm_model)$r.squared


```

```{r}
# Create the scatter plot with linear regression line, R-squared, and equation
ggplot(dose_result1, aes(x = totaldose_mg, y = labreads)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +    # Scatter plot points
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "red", linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(title = "linerar regression for Paracetamol",
       x = "daily dose in mg",
       y = " Sodium mmol/l") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = paste("R² =", round(r_squared, 2)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5, color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = 150, y = 10, label = equation, 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 3.5, size = 5, color = "black")
```

```{r}
dose_summary_data <- dose_result  %>% #filter(gender == "Female") %>% ## change (male and female for data to make graph)
  group_by(attribute) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_labread = mean(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_labread = sd(labreads, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )
max_value <- max(dose_summary_data$mean_labread + dose_summary_data$sem_labread, na.rm = TRUE)
breaks_up_to_500 <- seq(0, 500, by = 100)
additional_breaks <- if (max_value > 500) seq(600, max_value, by = 300) else numeric(0)
all_breaks <- c(breaks_up_to_500, additional_breaks)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Filter and prepare data
filtered_data <- dose_result %>% 
  filter(totaldose_mg %in% c(500,750,1000,1500,1750,2000,3000,4000,5000,7000,10000,13000)) %>%
  mutate(totaldose_mg = as.factor(totaldose_mg))

# Perform ANOVA
anova_result <- aov(labreads ~ totaldose_mg, data = filtered_data)

# Print summary of the ANOVA result
summary(anova_result)
# Perform Tukey's HSD post-hoc test
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)

# Print summary of the Tukey's HSD result
print(tukey_result)



```
